name: Artifact Threads
description: Conversations pinned to HTML. Review portable artifacts with GitHub issues, authorship, and @mentions. No backend.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://api.github.com https://github.com; frame-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-downloads; default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data: blob:; font-src data: blob:; media-src data: blob:; connect-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
